title: Meat, fish, eggs, dairy, fats, drinks, condiments and prepared foods
drafted_by: OpenAI Codex (GPT-5); revised by Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5) on the owner's behalf
notes: Policy table (knowledge repository, operations/ingredient-hierarchy/README.md section 5) confirmed by the owner on 2026-09-24: every default stands.
baked_beans: may_contain pork because four of six catalog recipes explicitly say pork and beans, while vegetarian versions exist.
broth and bouillon: generic forms may contain chicken or beef because recipe evidence names both meats plus vegetable and unspecified stocks.
pate and liver: pate may contain pork and is made from liver; catalog liver evidence is predominantly chicken liver.
eggnog, teriyaki and Worcestershire: conservative may_contain links cover common but non-guaranteed alcohol, egg or anchovy.

Name-component audit: ginger ale may contain real ginger, salt cod contains salt, and the vegetable-or-olive-oil option may contain olive; these are conservatively linked rather than rejected as look-alikes.
whipped_topping: may contain cream because catalog evidence mixes dairy whipped cream with non-dairy branded toppings.

Compound foods: where a sauce, paste, dumpling or mix commonly contains an ingredient the catalog names, it is linked may_contain (or made_from when defining) rather than left with no parent. Missing a link serves a household the food it refused; an extra link only removes a dish.
Parents may come from another package: chili_pepper, chipotle_pepper, sesame_seed, tapioca_flour, pomegranate_seeds, bonito_flakes, mustard_seed and cucumber_pickle are WP3 ids.

Oil policy (confirmed by the owner on 2026-09-24): olive, avocado, coconut, peanut, sunflower, grapeseed and sesame oils are not under their source. Allergies still reach them through the ingredient's own allergens. chili_oil stays under chili_pepper because the chilli is its purpose.
Gelatin (confirmed by the owner on 2026-09-24): may_contain beef as well as pork, because commercial gelatin is often bovine.
accepted_by remains null until the owner reads and accepts every entry.

grapefruit_juice: its only recipe line is pomelo juice. Pomelo and grapefruit are different fruits; the release's ingredient mapping conflates them. Not fixable in this table; recorded for the data owners.

either_of excludes the whole id, and must for now: the catalog prices a combined id as one product (beef_or_turkey buys minced beef, chicken_or_veg_broth buys chicken broth, milk_or_water buys milk). Keeping the recipe and choosing the other option needs the recipe and shopping path to resolve the choice first. 14 ids, 267 recipe uses; butter_or_margarine alone is 198.
